decisions.reason: As a visible extension of our established geospatial interoperability offer and already presented on its own page, these plug-ins fit our core business and are unlikely to be withdrawn so soon.

The building data digital twin service matches our strategic direction toward integrated, user-centered geospatial enterprise solutions, even if it still appears to be in an early market-building phase.

Authentication and identity delegation are important enabling capabilities for enterprise and public-sector GeoIT, but as an adjacent rather than central offer they carry some consolidation risk if demand stays limited.
An open GIS application development framework supports our platform-plus-services model and strengthens customer lock-in and project follow-on business, so we would normally continue it.

The newly launched identity and access service clearly supports seamless integration of GeoIT applications, although its proximity to Product C creates a moderate chance of later portfolio rationalization rather than near-term withdrawal.
